blocks.text: 33-darsda **should** — maslahat va fikr edi (→ 33-dars). Bu darsda u boshqacha ishlaydi: ba'zi fe'l va sifatlardan keyingi **that**-ergash gapda, **If ... should** («mabodo») qolipida va **I should think** («menimcha») iborasida. Bu holatlarda should ko'pincha «kerak» deb tarjima qilinmaydi: They insisted that we **should stay** — Ular **qolishimizni** talab qilishdi. Shuning uchun o'zbekchada fe'lning «**-ishini**» shakli, «**mabodo**», «**menimcha**» kabi vositalar ishlatiladi.
insist, demand, suggest, recommend, propose + that ... should

**insist** (qat'iy talab qilmoq), **demand** (talab qilmoq), **suggest** (taklif qilmoq, maslahat bermoq), **recommend** (tavsiya qilmoq), **propose** (taklif kiritmoq) dan keyin: **that** + ega + **should** + fe'l. Bu yerda should «kimdir shunday bo'lishini xohlayapti» degan ma'noni beradi. **should** tushirib qoldirilishi ham mumkin, unda fe'l **asosiy shaklda** qoladi — barcha shaxslarda `-s` siz: She insisted that he **pay**. Bu shakl rasmiyroq va Amerikada ko'p, lekin British English'da ham keng tarqalgan. Og'zaki nutqda **that** ko'pincha tushib qoladi: I suggest you **book** early.

rows: The doctor recommended that he **should walk** more.
The doctor recommended that he **walk** more.

items.text: Our guide insisted that we **should** try the local bread before leaving Samarkand.
items.translation: Gidimiz Samarqanddan ketishdan oldin mahalliy nonni **tatib ko'rishimizni** qattiq talab qildi.

items.text: The manager suggested that I **take** a few days off after the busy season.
items.translation: Menejer serqatnov mavsumdan keyin bir necha kun **dam olishimni** maslahat berdi.

blocks.text: O'zbekchadagi «menga borishni maslahat berdi» qolipi ko'pincha xato inglizcha gapga olib keladi: «She suggested me to go». **suggest** dan keyin «kishi + to + fe'l» ishlatilmaydi. To'g'ri variantlar: She suggested **that I** (should) **go**; agar so'zlovchi ham ishtirok etsa — She suggested **going** (`-ing`, → 53-dars); yoki ot bilan — She suggested **a walk**. «Kishi + to» qolipi **advise** fe'lida bor: She **advised me to go** (→ 55-dars).

items.text: Kate suggested **going** for a walk after dinner, and everyone agreed.
items.translation: Keyt kechki ovqatdan keyin **sayrga chiqishni** taklif qildi va hamma rozi bo'ldi.

items.text: My tutor advised me **to read** more English newspapers.
items.translation: Repetitorim menga ko'proq inglizcha gazeta **o'qishni** maslahat berdi.

blocks.text: It's important that ... should; It's strange that ... should

**important, essential, vital, necessary, urgent** sifatlaridan keyin ham **that ... should** (yoki asosiy shakl) keladi: It's essential that everyone **should** arrive on time — Hammaning vaqtida **kelishi** juda muhim. **strange, odd, funny, typical, surprising, a pity** kabi his-tuyg'u sifatlaridan keyin esa should biror voqeaga **munosabatni** bildiradi, majburiyatni emas: It's strange that he **should** say that = It's strange that he **said** that — Uning shunday **degani** g'alati. O'zbekchada bunday gaplarda «kerak» so'zi ishlatilmaydi.

items.text: It's vital that the driver **should** rest every two hours on a long journey.
items.translation: Uzoq yo'lda haydovchining har ikki soatda **dam olishi** hayotiy muhim.

items.text: How odd that the shop **should** close on the busiest day of the year!
items.translation: Do'konning aynan yilning eng gavjum kunida **yopilishi** qanday g'alati!

blocks.text: **If** + **should** + fe'l — holat kam ehtimolli, tasodifan yuz berishi mumkin: «**mabodo**», «**basharti**». If anyone **should** call, take a message — Mabodo kimdir qo'ng'iroq qilsa, xabarini yozib oling. Natija qismida odatda buyruq, **will** yoki **can** keladi. Rasmiy uslubda (xat, e'lon, yo'riqnoma) **if** tushib qoladi va **should** gap boshiga chiqadi: **Should** you **need** any help, please contact us. Bu inversiya ish yozishmalarida juda ko'p uchraydi.

rows: **If you should need** help, call me.

items.text: If the shop **should** run out of bread, buy some biscuits instead.
items.translation: **Mabodo** do'konda non **tugab qolsa**, o'rniga pechenye ol.

items.text: **Should** you wish to cancel your booking, please let us know 48 hours in advance.
items.translation: Bronni **bekor qilmoqchi bo'lsangiz**, iltimos, 48 soat oldin xabar bering.

blocks.text: I should think / I should imagine — ehtiyotkor taxmin

**I should think**, **I should imagine**, **I should say** = I would think: «**menimcha**», «**shunday bo'lsa kerak**» — so'zlovchi ehtiyotkorlik bilan taxmin qiladi. Inkori: **I shouldn't think** so — «Unday emasdir». Bu yerda should hech qanday majburiyatni bildirmaydi. Rasmiy British xatlarida **I should be grateful** if you could ... — «...sangiz, minnatdor bo'lardim» iborasi ham uchraydi (= I would be grateful).

items.text: **I should think** the flight to London takes about six hours.
items.translation: **Menimcha**, Londonga parvoz olti soatcha davom etadi.

items.text: Will Aziz mind if we borrow his tent? — **I shouldn't think** so.
items.translation: Azizning chodirini olib tursak, qarshi bo'lmaydimi? — **Unday emasdir**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «They suggested me to stay» → They suggested **that I** (should) **stay** yoki They suggested **staying**; «The doctor recommended him to rest» → recommended **that he** (should) **rest**; «If anyone should to call» → If anyone **should call** (should dan keyin `to` yo'q); «Should you will need» → **Should you need** (inversiyada will yo'q); «I should think» ni «o'ylashim kerak» deb tarjima qilish → bu «**menimcha**».

**Should you ...** bilan boshlangan gapni tushunish uchun uni **If you ...** ga aylantiring: Should you have any questions → If you have any questions. Rasmiy xat yozganda esa aksincha: «If you have any questions» o'rniga **Should you have any questions** yozsangiz, uslub darhol jiddiyroq eshitiladi.

rows: insist / demand / suggest / recommend / propose + that ... **should** (yoki asosiy shakl)
It's odd that he **should** be late.

examples.title: **insist** / **demand** that ... **should**
examples.description: insist va demand dan keyin that + ega + should + fe'l: kimdir nimadir bo'lishini qat'iy talab qiladi. O'zbekchada «-ishini talab qildi».

sentences.text: My parents insisted that I **should** finish my degree before working abroad.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam chet elda ishlashdan oldin o'qishimni **tugatishimni** qat'iy talab qilishdi.

sentences.text: The customer demanded that the manager **should** refund the full price immediately.
sentences.translation: Mijoz menejer to'liq narxni darhol **qaytarib berishini** talab qildi.

sentences.text: Our hosts in Bukhara insisted that we **should** stay for dinner.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi mezbonlarimiz bizni kechki ovqatga **qolishga** qistab turib olishdi.

sentences.text: Doctors are demanding that the hospital **should** hire more nurses.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar shifoxona ko'proq hamshira **ishga olishini** talab qilishmoqda.

sentences.text: Why does Kate always insist that everyone **should** take their shoes off at the door?
sentences.translation: Nega Keyt doim hamma eshik oldida **poyabzalini yechishini** talab qiladi?

sentences.text: The union is demanding that workers **should** get a ten percent pay rise.
sentences.translation: Kasaba uyushmasi ishchilarning maoshi o'n foizga **oshirilishini** talab qilmoqda.

sentences.text: James insisted that we **shouldn't** pay for anything during our visit.
sentences.translation: Jeyms tashrifimiz davomida hech narsaga **pul to'lamasligimizni** qat'iy talab qildi.

sentences.text: Instead of arguing, Dilnoza insisted that the team **should** vote on the decision.
sentences.translation: Bahslashish o'rniga Dilnoza jamoa qaror bo'yicha **ovoz berishini** talab qildi.

sentences.text: The protesters demanded that the minister **should** resign.
sentences.translation: Namoyishchilar vazirning **iste'foga chiqishini** talab qilishdi.

sentences.text: Although I felt fine, the nurse insisted that I **should** stay in bed for another day.
sentences.translation: O'zimni yaxshi his qilsam ham, hamshira yana bir kun **yotishimni** aytib turib oldi.

examples.title: **suggest** / **recommend** / **propose** ... **should**
examples.description: suggest, recommend, propose dan keyin that ... should: taklif va tavsiya. O'zbekchada «-ishini taklif qildi / tavsiya qildi».

sentences.text: The travel agent suggested that we **should** visit Samarkand in autumn, when it's cooler.
sentences.translation: Turagent Samarqandga kuzda, havo salqinroq bo'lganda **borishimizni** maslahat berdi.

sentences.text: I suggest that you **should** read the contract carefully before you sign anything.
sentences.translation: Biror narsaga imzo chekishdan oldin shartnomani diqqat bilan **o'qib chiqishingizni** taklif qilaman.

sentences.text: The doctor recommended that Aziz **should** cut down on sugar and salt.
sentences.translation: Shifokor Azizga shakar va tuzni **kamaytirishni** tavsiya qildi.

sentences.text: Emma proposed that the team **should** meet online every Monday morning.
sentences.translation: Emma jamoa har dushanba ertalab onlayn **yig'ilishini** taklif qildi.

sentences.text: What do you suggest I **should** say to her? — Just tell her the truth.
sentences.translation: Unga nima **deyishimni** maslahat berasiz? — Shunchaki haqiqatni ayting.

sentences.text: Experts recommend that office workers **should** stand up and move every hour.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislar ofis xodimlariga har soatda **o'rnidan turib harakat qilishni** tavsiya qiladi.

sentences.text: My teacher suggested that I **should** take the advanced course instead of the general one.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchim umumiy kurs o'rniga yuqori darajali **kursga yozilishimni** maslahat berdi.

sentences.text: It was Sarah who proposed that we **should** share the cost of the taxi.
sentences.translation: Taksi pulini **teng bo'lishishimizni** Sara taklif qilgan edi.

sentences.text: The report recommends that the city **should** build more cycle lanes.
sentences.translation: Hisobotda shaharda ko'proq **velosiped yo'lagi qurish** tavsiya qilinadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod suggested that we **shouldn't** tell anyone about the plan until it was approved.
sentences.translation: Bekzod reja tasdiqlanmaguncha bu haqda hech kimga **aytmasligimizni** taklif qildi.

examples.title: Without **should**: suggest you **book**, insist he **pay**
examples.description: should tushib qolishi mumkin: fe'l asosiy shaklda (barcha shaxslarda -s siz). suggest dan keyin -ing yoki ot ham keladi.

sentences.text: I suggest you **book** the tickets now, before the prices go up.
sentences.translation: Narxlar oshmasidan oldin chiptalarni hozir **band qilishingizni** maslahat beraman.

sentences.text: The bank insisted that he **pay** the whole loan back within a year.
sentences.translation: Bank undan butun qarzni bir yil ichida **to'lashini** talab qildi.

sentences.text: Madina suggested **going** to the cinema, but everyone else wanted to stay in.
sentences.translation: Madina kinoga **borishni** taklif qildi, lekin qolganlar uyda qolishni xohlashdi.

sentences.text: The coach recommended that each player **drink** at least two litres of water a day.
sentences.translation: Murabbiy har bir o'yinchiga kuniga kamida ikki litr **suv ichishni** tavsiya qildi.

sentences.text: We suggested **meeting** at the station, as it's easier for everybody.
sentences.translation: Hamma uchun qulayroq bo'lgani uchun bekatda **uchrashishni** taklif qildik.

sentences.text: My landlord has demanded that I **leave** the flat by the end of the month.
sentences.translation: Uy egasi oy oxirigacha kvartirani **bo'shatishimni** talab qildi.

sentences.text: What do you suggest? — I suggest we **take** the early train and have breakfast on the way.
sentences.translation: Nima taklif qilasiz? — Erta poyezdga **chiqishimizni** va yo'lda nonushta qilishimizni taklif qilaman.

sentences.text: Oliver suggested a short **walk** after lunch to wake everyone up.
sentences.translation: Oliver hammani tetiklashtirish uchun tushlikdan keyin qisqa **sayr qilishni** taklif qildi.

sentences.text: The judge ordered that the company **pay** compensation to all its former employees.
sentences.translation: Sudya kompaniya barcha sobiq xodimlariga **tovon to'lashini** buyurdi.

sentences.text: Instead of a hotel, Nilufar suggested that we **rent** a small house near the lake.
sentences.translation: Nilufar mehmonxona o'rniga ko'l yaqinidan kichkina uy **ijaraga olishimizni** taklif qildi.

examples.title: **It's important** / **essential that** ... **should**
examples.description: important, essential, vital, necessary, urgent + that ... should: nima muhim yoki zarur ekanini aytish. O'zbekchada «-ishi muhim».

sentences.text: It's important that every new employee **should** feel welcome from the first day.
sentences.translation: Har bir yangi xodim birinchi kundanoq o'zini **xush kutib olingandek his qilishi** muhim.

sentences.text: It's essential that the patient **should** take these tablets at the same time every day.
sentences.translation: Bemorning bu tabletkalarni har kuni bir vaqtda **ichishi** shart.

sentences.text: For safety reasons, it's vital that nobody **should** enter the lab without a mask.
sentences.translation: Xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan, hech kim laboratoriyaga niqobsiz **kirmasligi** juda muhim.

sentences.text: The school believes it's important that children **should** learn to manage their time.
sentences.translation: Maktab bolalarning vaqtini **boshqarishni o'rganishi** muhim deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: In my opinion, it is essential that both sides **should** agree before the work begins.
sentences.translation: Mening fikrimcha, ish boshlanishidan oldin ikki tomon **kelishib olishi** zarur.

sentences.text: Isn't it important that the public **should** know the truth about the project?
sentences.translation: Jamoatchilikning loyiha haqidagi haqiqatni **bilishi** muhim emasmi?

sentences.text: Our manager says it's necessary that we **should** all attend the training next week.
sentences.translation: Menejerimizning aytishicha, kelasi haftadagi treningda hammamiz **qatnashishimiz** zarur.

sentences.text: It was important to us that the wedding **should** be small and simple.
sentences.translation: To'yning kichik va oddiy **bo'lishi** biz uchun muhim edi.

sentences.text: With so many tourists arriving, it's urgent that the city **should** improve its public toilets.
sentences.translation: Shuncha sayyoh kelayotgan ekan, shaharning jamoat hojatxonalarini **yaxshilashi** shoshilinch zarur.

sentences.text: Why is it so important that everything **should** be perfect for your mother's visit?
sentences.translation: Nega onangiz kelishiga hamma narsaning mukammal **bo'lishi** shunchalik muhim?

examples.title: **It's strange** / **typical that** ... **should**
examples.description: strange, odd, funny, typical, surprising, a pity + that ... should — voqeaga munosabat: ajablanish, achinish, tanqid. Bu yerda should «kerak» degani emas.

sentences.text: It's strange that Tom **should** be late — he's usually so punctual.
sentences.translation: Tomning **kechikishi** g'alati — u odatda juda vaqtida keladi.

sentences.text: How typical that Jasur **should** fall ill on the first day of his holiday!
sentences.translation: Har doimgidek: Jasur aynan ta'tilining birinchi kuni **kasal bo'lib qoldi**!

sentences.text: Isn't it odd that such a popular café **should** close so suddenly?
sentences.translation: Shunday mashhur kafening to'satdan **yopilib qolishi** g'alati emasmi?

sentences.text: I was surprised that she **should** say such a thing in front of her boss.
sentences.translation: Uning boshlig'i oldida bunday gap **aytgani** meni hayron qoldirdi.

sentences.text: What a pity that our best player **should** get injured just before the final!
sentences.translation: Eng yaxshi o'yinchimizning aynan finaldan oldin **jarohat olgani** qanday achinarli!

sentences.text: How odd that Kate and I **should** meet again in a tiny village in Scotland after twenty years!
sentences.translation: Qanday g'alati: Keyt bilan yigirma yildan keyin Shotlandiyadagi kichkina qishloqda yana **uchrashib qoldik**!

sentences.text: It's funny that you **should** mention Bukhara — I've just booked a trip there!
sentences.translation: Buxoroni **tilga olganingiz** qiziq — hozirgina u yerga sayohat band qildim!

sentences.text: Sarah found it surprising that a five-star hotel **should** charge for Wi-Fi.
sentences.translation: Besh yulduzli mehmonxonaning Wi-Fi uchun **pul olishi** Sarani hayron qoldirdi.

sentences.text: Many people think it's wrong that ordinary families **should** pay more tax than big companies.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik oddiy oilalarning yirik kompaniyalardan ko'proq **soliq to'lashini** adolatsizlik deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: I find it odd that such an obvious mistake **should** go unnoticed for so long.
sentences.translation: Shunday aniq xatoning shuncha vaqt **e'tibordan chetda qolishi** menga g'alati tuyuladi.

examples.title: **If** ... **should** / **Should** you ...: just in case
examples.description: If ... should — kam ehtimolli holat: «mabodo». Rasmiy uslubda if tushib qoladi va gap Should bilan boshlanadi.

sentences.text: If anyone **should** call while I'm out, please take a message.
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda **mabodo** kimdir **qo'ng'iroq qilsa**, iltimos, xabarini yozib oling.

sentences.text: Let me know if you **should** need any help with the move.
sentences.translation: Ko'chishda **mabodo** yordam **kerak bo'lsa**, menga xabar bering.

sentences.text: **Should** you have any questions about your order, please contact our support team.
sentences.translation: Buyurtmangiz bo'yicha **savollaringiz bo'lsa**, qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmatimizga murojaat qiling.

sentences.text: If the flight **should** arrive late, a driver will wait for you at the exit.
sentences.translation: **Mabodo** reys **kechikib kelsa**, haydovchi sizni chiqishda kutib turadi.

sentences.text: The match will continue tomorrow if it **should** rain this evening.
sentences.translation: **Mabodo** bugun kechqurun **yomg'ir yog'sa**, o'yin ertaga davom etadi.

sentences.text: **Should** the price go up again, we'll look for a cheaper supplier.
sentences.translation: Agar narx yana **oshib qolsa**, arzonroq yetkazib beruvchi qidiramiz.

sentences.text: Please wake me up if the baby **should** start crying in the night.
sentences.translation: **Mabodo** kechasi chaqaloq **yig'lab qolsa**, iltimos, meni uyg'oting.

sentences.text: **Should** you change your mind, the job offer is still open until Friday.
sentences.translation: **Fikringizni o'zgartirsangiz**, ish taklifi juma kunigacha o'z kuchida.

sentences.text: What will you do if the bank **should** refuse your loan application?
sentences.translation: **Mabodo** bank kredit arizangizni **rad etsa**, nima qilasiz?

sentences.text: Our neighbours will feed the cat if we **should** decide to stay in Fergana longer.
sentences.translation: **Mabodo** Farg'onada uzoqroq **qolishga qaror qilsak**, qo'shnilarimiz mushukka ovqat berib turadi.

examples.title: **I should think** / **I should imagine**: a careful guess
examples.description: I should think / imagine / say = «menimcha», «shunday bo'lsa kerak». I shouldn't think so — «unday emasdir». Rasmiy xatda: I should be grateful if ...

sentences.text: **I should think** the repairs will take about two weeks.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, ta'mir taxminan ikki hafta davom etadi.

sentences.text: Will there be many people at the concert? — **I should imagine** so; it's sold out.
sentences.translation: Konsertda odam ko'p bo'ladimi? — **Shunday bo'lsa kerak**, chiptalar tugagan.

sentences.text: **I shouldn't think** Kate will mind if we arrive a bit early.
sentences.translation: Biroz erta borsak, Keyt **qarshi bo'lmasa kerak**.

sentences.text: A flat like that in central London costs a fortune, **I should imagine**.
sentences.translation: Londonning markazida bunday kvartira juda **qimmat tursa kerak**.

sentences.text: How long will the drive to Khiva take? — Twelve hours at least, **I should think**.
sentences.translation: Xivagacha mashinada qancha vaqt ketadi? — **Menimcha**, kamida o'n ikki soat.

sentences.text: Is Madina still angry with you? — **I shouldn't think** so; she called me this morning.
sentences.translation: Madina hali ham sizdan xafami? — **Unday emasdir**, bugun ertalab menga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: Given the snow, **I should imagine** most flights will leave late tonight.
sentences.translation: Qorni hisobga olsak, bugun kechqurun ko'p reyslar **kechikib uchsa kerak**.

sentences.text: She's about forty, **I should say**, but it's hard to tell.
sentences.translation: U qirq yoshlarda **bo'lsa kerak**, lekin aniq aytish qiyin.

sentences.text: With three cameras and a huge screen, the new model will be expensive, **I should think**.
sentences.translation: Uchta kamera va katta ekran bilan yangi model **qimmat bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: **I should be grateful** if you could send me the invoice by Friday.
sentences.translation: Hisob-fakturani juma kunigacha yuborsangiz, **minnatdor bo'lardim**.

examples.title: Mixed: demands, warnings and guesses
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: that ... should, should siz asosiy shakl, If ... should / Should you ..., I should think.

sentences.text: The hotel manager insisted that we **should** have a free dinner to make up for the noise.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona menejeri shovqin uchun uzr sifatida bepul kechki ovqat **yeyishimizni** qat'iy taklif qildi.

sentences.text: **Should** you lose your bank card abroad, call this number immediately.
sentences.translation: Chet elda bank kartangizni **yo'qotib qo'ysangiz**, darhol shu raqamga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's tutor suggested she **apply** to universities in both Tashkent and Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning repetitori unga Toshkent va Edinburgdagi universitetlarga **hujjat topshirishni** maslahat berdi.

sentences.text: It's essential that the children **should** wear helmets when they go cycling.
sentences.translation: Bolalarning velosiped haydaganda **dubulg'a kiyishi** shart.

sentences.text: How strange that you **should** ring just as I was writing to you!
sentences.translation: Qanday g'alati: aynan sizga xat yozayotganimda **qo'ng'iroq qilib qoldingiz**!

sentences.text: If anything **should** go wrong with the heating, the landlord will pay for the repair.
sentences.translation: **Mabodo** isitish tizimida biror nosozlik **chiqsa**, ta'mir uchun uy egasi to'laydi.

sentences.text: Will the shops be open on Sunday? — Not in the morning, **I should think**.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni do'konlar ochiq bo'ladimi? — Ertalab ochiq **bo'lmasa kerak**.

sentences.text: The committee recommended that the old cinema **should** become a cultural centre.
sentences.translation: Qo'mita eski kinoteatrning madaniyat markaziga **aylanishini** tavsiya qildi.

sentences.text: My grandfather always insists that the whole family **should** eat together on Fridays.
sentences.translation: Bobom doim butun oila juma kunlari birga **ovqatlanishini** talab qiladi.

sentences.text: Was it really necessary that everybody **should** know about my salary?
sentences.translation: Mening maoshim haqida hammaning **bilishi** rostdan ham shartmidi?
